name: asset
why: The only group that mints an asset. An asset coin in the shared float changes what every later sats-only spend can select, so nothing that measures the sats float runs beside it.

name: lifecycle
why: The only group on a BLOCK-typed arkd, which is what blockTimelocks exists to cover and what the compose defaults happen to give. vtxoLifecycle rides along: it reads the wallet's own float, so it wants one with no minted asset in it and a server still charging its intent fees, since its headline assertion is the ABSENCE of INTENT_INSUFFICIENT_FEE.

name: send-lightning
why: Needs the boltz profile: the counterparty is the base `lnd`, the solver's own node is `boltz-lnd`, and setupBoltz() is the only thing that funds that node and opens the channel between them. Seconds-typed, like every corridor group: the receive orchestrator refuses to write a block-height refund deadline without a chainTip provider, and these tests wire none. sendLightningApproval rides here because it is the same stack and the same corridor: it sets the approval threshold on its OWN service rather than in the shared env, so no other group's swaps are gated.

name: receive-lightning
why: The one group that also needs covclaimd: covclaimdClaim proves the daemon claims a lockup nobody in the test ever claims, and receiveLightningEdges has a reveal test that requires it. Separate from send-lightning because covclaimd watches arkd's tx stream and sweeps preimage-gated lockups, which the send legs do not want happening under them.

name: onchain
why: Same stack as send-lightning; split for run time and for attribution, since these five files confirm real transactions and are the slowest set here.

name: self-payment
why: Same stack as send-lightning; split for run time and for attribution.

name: evm
why: Needs two stacks at once: arkade-regtest for the Arkade leg and `scripts/e2e-stack.mjs` for anvil plus the flat price feed on :8088. priceFeed rides along because it is the only other file that reads that feed.
